title: Machine Learning Analysis of Immune Cells for Diagnosis and Prognosis of Cutaneous Melanoma.
summary: Machine learning on five melanoma expression cohorts produced diagnostic/prognostic immune-cell signatures and a disease-specific high-risk immune phenotype.
ai_technology: ssGSEA quantified 24 immune-cell populations; multiple ML feature-selection/classification methods selected diagnostic and prognostic patterns.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Results include tumor/control immune-cell differences and survival-risk subgroup associations in melanoma datasets.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective GEO/TCGA cohorts and cross-dataset analysis; no prospective clinical validation.
evidence.ai_role: ssGSEA quantified 24 immune-cell populations; multiple ML feature-selection/classification methods selected diagnostic and prognostic patterns.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
